description: One template per distinct page shape in the Foreplay clone. Nodes are structured objects; shell.navbar is always first, shell.footer and shell.exit-intent-modal are last (paid-landing has no footer). Optional nodes carry a data condition.

nodeFields.condition: data state under which an optional node appears
